desc: Ideate approaches and select the segment-tree monoid gap-concatenation approach.

Implement the segment-tree monoid solution in the provided starter code: define a node merge for `(sum, pref, suff, best)`, build an iterative range-query structure, compute the baseline maximum subarray sum, map values to occurrence positions, and for each deletable value merge the non-empty gaps between occurrences to update the answer while handling edge cases.
Validate the implementation against the provided examples and edge cases such as single-element arrays, all-negative arrays, all-equal arrays, empty gaps, and values that occur everywhere.
